page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6t.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced resource allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no graphics processing units bundled with this configuration, making it reliant entirely on the host CPU for all computational tasks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g6t.xlarge offers a balanced resource profile suitable for standard enterprise workloads that do not require specialized hardware accelerators or high-speed local NVMe storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. Appropriate workloads for this instance type include general-purpose web serving, application hosting, microservices, and development or testing environments.
